rationale: P balance gives p_diesel + p_inverter = 34; minimizing cost means maximizing p_inverter at its availability limit 20 MW, so p_diesel = 14 MW (within 8-45). Setting q_diesel = q_preferred = 4 MVAr (within -10..18) removes the deviation penalty, with q_inverter = 12 - 4 = 8 MVAr. Inverter apparent power: sqrt(20^2 + 8^2) = 21.54 <= 24 MVA. Voltage = 0.965 + 0.0025*(4+8) = 0.995 pu, within 0.95-1.05. Cost = 14*76 + 0*3 = 1064.0.
